entries.title: Until Dawn

emulation.notes: Use the native 2024 PC remake for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with scalable resolution/settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The 2024 remake is rebuilt for PS5 and PC with Unreal Engine 5, graphical improvements, new camera/control work, added interactions, an extended prologue, and new endings; the Windows PC release is the highest-fidelity capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Until Dawn on Steam and play the 2024 Windows PC remake. Use the PS4 original only if you specifically want the original fixed-camera/Decima-era presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS4 release using the original presentation and controls.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically important original, but the 2024 remake adds new scenes/endings and modern fidelity; no separate exclusive-content route is required.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC remake with Unreal Engine 5 presentation and scalable PC settings.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity/capture route and includes the remake's added scenes, interactions, and endings.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 remake with the same rebuilt presentation.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced content advantage over the PC remake.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The 2024 remake is the fidelity/completeness pick because it adds scenes/endings and modern presentation, but players seeking the original fixed-camera PS4 mood may still prefer the historical original.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2024 version is a remake/rebuild rather than a simple port: it changes presentation and adds interactions, an extended prologue, Hunger Totems, and new endings while keeping the core story largely the same.

entries.title: Until Dawn: Rush of Blood

emulation.notes: Requires PlayStation VR hardware and PlayStation Camera.

primary.why: Rush of Blood is an Until Dawn VR rail-shooter spin-off released exclusively for PlayStation VR, so PS4 with PS VR is the only sourced route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Until Dawn: Rush of Blood on PlayStation Store and play on PS4 with PlayStation VR, PlayStation Camera, and supported controller setup.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform route and intended VR presentation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or content split exists in sourced public data.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR spin-off, not a remake/remaster of Until Dawn.
